innovative.label: U.S. News Most Innovative
innovative.def: All 74 universities on the U.S. News 2027 Most Innovative National Universities list, published September 2026.

note: Two codings of the same 71 AAU member institutions. (1) Innovation: each institution's two strongest education initiatives, each scored 2×Novelty + Scale + Evidence (0–5 each, max 20); portfolio = mean of the top two, a missing second counts as 0. (2) Response to portable funding: direction (compete / supply / fortify / evidence / none) and which of four lenses showed a verified signal. Source: public university pages and news, 2025–2026. 'none' means not found in this scan, not proven absent. Most Innovative rows not in the AAU are coded for response only; their initiatives are not yet scored. 'since' is the verified start year of the work cited; it is absent where no source states one. Recheck of 28 Oct 2026: the 70 'none' rows were searched beyond the education school (K–12, online, charter, lab-school and outreach units); 17 were recoded, each marked 'recoded'.

directions.compete: Builds or runs an alternative that takes portable funds
directions.supply: Sells services or preparation to whoever is buying, including non-public schools
directions.evidence: Studies or debates the policy rather than acting in the market
directions.none: No response observed in this scan
